attributes.echno.dev-note: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Imported by docker-compose.dev.yml into the dev Keycloak. Every password and secret in this file is a public dev-only literal; none of them exists on any deployed instance. The backend's KeycloakInitializer reconciles this realm on each boot (clients, composite job roles, the echno-admin and echno-service accounts, the echno-local-dev fixture with its organization), so the import only has to carry what a first token needs.

clients.name: Echno backend (local dev)
clients.description: Service accounts and authorization services are switched on by the backend's KeycloakInitializer on its first boot, not here: Keycloak 26.0.x fails a startup import that carries a service-account client (Session not bound to a realm).

clients.name: Local dev token client (curl only)
clients.description: Password grant for a first token from the command line. Not reconciled by the backend and never present on a deployed realm.
